subject: ClearBank — Compliance onboarding: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test scheduling
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearBank — Compliance onboarding: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test scheduling

Hi Liam —

Great to meet you on the call yesterday. We're excited to get the compliance onboarding started for ClearBank Solutions. To keep this moving, can we align on:

- A 90-minute live walkthrough covering: SOC 2 controls mapping, DPA clause review, and pen-test scope/approach.
- Who from your side will be the security SME (network/infra + application)?
- Any vendor constraints for pen-test (approved vendors, blackout windows)?

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 1: 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed Aug 2: 11:00–12:30

I've attached a short SOC 2 overview and an initial DPA draft for your review. If you prefer a shorter 45-minute session to start, we can split the topics across two calls.

Links: shared Drive folder (SOC/DPA) below.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0143

Attachments: SOC2-redwood-overview.pdf (PDF), DPA-Draft-ClearBank.docx
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 21 Jul 2028 15:40:12 -0400
Subject: Re: ClearBank — Compliance onboarding: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test scheduling

Vanessa —

Thanks for the notes and attachments. Quick answers:
- I'll be the primary security contact; copying security@clearbank.com.
- Our infra SME (network) will be Priya Mahadevan (cc'ed on the calendar invite once confirmed).
- For pen-tests, our procurement requires use of an approved vendor list; PenTestOps is on it (I've copied pentestops@vendor.com).

The proposed windows mostly work. Can you do any earlier slots for our London-based engineering lead? If not, Wed Aug 2 11:00–12:30 PST is acceptable.

Also please share the minimum evidence list (logs/audit trails) so we can start pulling items.

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Security | ClearBank Solutions
liam.oconnor@clearbank.com

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the fast reply. Wed Aug 2 11:00–12:30 PST is tentatively reserved on our side. If your London lead needs an earlier slot, we can move to Tue Aug 1 09:00–10:30 PST and loop in an engineer asynchronously.

Minimal evidence checklist (quick starter):
- Admin activity logs (AWS/GCP console activity export, last 90 days)
- Access control policy docs and role mappings
- Network diagram and segment controls (high level)
- Data retention policy and encryption-at-rest notes

I'll also start a calendar invite and include a short agenda. Karthik, can you add the environment/infra bullets and attach the DPA redlines we usually send?

Vanessa
